title: Script (FRust) panel
summary: The Script panel edits FRust source, the Djehuti Suite language, and checks it with Compile.

blocks.text: The Script panel is titled Djehuti Suite Language (FRust). It has a source editor and an output area. Press Compile to check the source: the output says "Compiled cleanly." or shows the compiler's messages.
Save to your library keeps the source; Load a saved .frust file brings one back; Export becomes available after a clean compile.
Compile runs the FRust compiler, which works on files, so pressing it writes two temporary files. Compiling only happens when you press Compile.
